settings.label: Speech Enabled
settings.text: Select this check box to turn listening on. Clear it to turn listening off. In push-to-talk mode, a click on it turns listening on and changes the mode to toggle mode. If the wake word is off and you turn speech off, only the keyboard or mouse can turn speech on again.

settings.label: Show Floating Button
settings.text: Select this check box to show the floating button. Clear it to hide the floating button. In push-to-talk mode, the floating button is the only way to listen, because you hold it down while you speak.

settings.label: Interim Results
settings.text: Select this check box to see the words while you speak. WheelHouse types them as the speech engine hears them, and corrects them when you finish the sentence. Clear it to see the words only after the speech engine finishes each sentence.

settings.label: Push-to-Talk Mode
settings.text: Select this check box to listen only while you hold the floating button down. During the hold, WheelHouse makes the computer's sound quiet. Clear it to use toggle mode: one click turns listening on, and the next click turns it off. You can also say "push to talk mode" or "click to talk mode".

settings.label: Debug
settings.text: Select this check box to write more detail into the log files. Clear it to write the usual detail. Keep it clear unless you must find or report a problem. This choice lasts until WheelHouse restarts.

settings.label: STT Provider
settings.text: Select a radio button to choose the speech engine. The list shows only the engines that are set up on this computer. WheelHouse keeps your choice after a restart. An engine whose speech model is not installed shows as a button. Click that button to see an offer to download the model.

settings.label: AI Model
settings.text: Select a radio button to choose the AI model. The list shows the model in your settings and, for an AI server on this computer, the other models that the server offers. When the AI features are off or not set up, the list shows an item that you cannot select, which says that AI is off or not set up. When your settings name a model, a second item that you cannot select names it.

settings.label: Check for updates
settings.text: Select this check box to let WheelHouse ask GitHub once a day if a newer release exists. When one exists, a notice offers to install it. Clear it to stop the check. WheelHouse then sends no update request.

settings.label: Log transcripts
settings.text: Select this check box to write the words you dictate and your clipboard contents into the log files. Clear it to keep them out of the log files. Select it only while you look for a recognition problem, then clear it again. While it is selected, the log files keep everything you dictate, passwords also. The change takes effect after a restart.

settings.label: Replacement timeout
settings.text: The time that WheelHouse waits after you stop speaking before it decides that a correction phrase is complete. The Decrease and Increase buttons change the time by 100 milliseconds, from 200 to 3000 milliseconds. Increase the time if corrections start before you finish speaking. Decrease it if WheelHouse is slow to respond. The change takes effect after a restart.

settings.label: Command timeout
settings.text: The time that WheelHouse waits after you stop speaking before it decides that a command phrase is complete. The Decrease and Increase buttons change the time by 100 milliseconds, from 200 to 3000 milliseconds. Increase the time if commands start before you finish speaking. Decrease it if WheelHouse is slow to respond. The change takes effect after a restart.

settings.label: Audio suppression
settings.text: Select a radio button to choose when WheelHouse stops listening while this computer plays sound. Auto stops listening only when Windows reports that the microphone has no echo canceller, or cannot answer. On stops listening whenever sound plays. Off never stops listening; without an echo canceller, expect more recognition errors, because the microphone hears the sound. The change takes effect after a restart.

settings.label: Wake word
settings.text: Select this check box to let the wake word turn listening on again. In toggle mode, when listening is off for any reason, say the wake word to turn listening on. In push-to-talk mode, the wake word ends only the pause that starts when you step away. If the wake word is off and you turn speech off, only the keyboard or mouse can turn speech on again. The change takes effect after a restart.
